title: 第9章 一门双上位第10章 父与子
content_zh:
;;
“哥。”
“哥！你回来了？想死你了。”客厅内，两道声音几乎同时响起，前者喜悦，后者更是透着一丝激动。
身材高挑的白色校服少女冲上来，直接激动地跳上去抱住方羽的脖子，半趴在了方羽的背上。
“思月，我刚练完拳，一身汗。”方羽笑道。
“我等会也要洗澡。”少女笑嘻嘻道：“小龙，你把我书包一起带上楼去。”
身材壮硕、脸上还带有一丝稚气的精悍少年无奈一笑，似乎早已习惯了对方。
“小龙，听你姐的，先去放东西，等会下来吃饭。”方羽笑道。
这正是他的弟弟妹妹，一对双胞胎。
妹妹方思月，排行第二。
弟弟方龙，排行第三。
今年都是15岁。
“哥，你竟然会做饭？做了什么好吃的？”方思月好奇看向厨房，没有炒菜的迹象啊。
“热了高能营养餐，正在保温。”方羽笑道。
“啊！”少女哀嚎一声：“我就知道，哥，枉我对你期待半天，我不吃营养餐，我要爷爷帮我点外卖！！！”
“外卖不健康，你们都开始武道修炼，必须注意饮食了。”方羽笑着，宠溺地摸了摸对方的丸子头。
武道修炼。
在未达到很高层次前，要忍受孤独寂寞，要忍受各种痛苦，更要放弃许多东西，例如——美食！
……
长兄拳头如父。

在方羽‘循循善诱’下，方思月、方龙很‘听话’的吃完方羽准备的高能营养餐。
饭后。
“武道天赋检测，怎么样？”方羽主动询问。
两人对视一眼，都露出笑容。
“哥，在仪器帮助下，我们都进入了深度沉睡。”方龙憨憨笑道：“我和姐姐都观想到了一道星相，是一条蟒，并进行了初步的‘星力入体’尝试。”
“蟒？”方羽眼前一亮。
成初级武者前，普通人限于身体孱弱，精神力不够强，哪怕觉醒了虚空星相，自身也难以察觉。
所以，要利用特殊仪器辅助，进入深度沉睡状态。
才能测定是否觉醒星相。
这是最近十多年才出现的仪器，也是最近几年，蓝月联盟天才武者不断涌现的原因。
毕竟，越早发现天赋，越早培养，完美利用黄金修炼时间，未来成超级强者概率也更高。
content_en:

"Brother."
"Brother! Are you back? I miss you so much." In the living room, two voices sounded almost at the same time, the former was happy, and the latter was even more excited.
The tall girl in white school uniform rushed forward, jumped up excitedly and hugged Fang Yu's neck, half lying on Fang Yu's back.
"Siyue, I just finished practicing boxing and I'm sweating all over." Fang Yu said with a smile.
"I'm going to take a shower later." The girl said with a smile, "Xiaolong, take my schoolbag upstairs with you."
The strong young man with a strong body and a hint of childishness on his face smiled helplessly, as if he was already used to the other person.
"Xiaolong, listen to your sister, go put your things away first and come down for dinner later." Fang Yu said with a smile.
These are his younger siblings, a pair of twins.
Sister Fang Siyue, ranked second.
The younger brother Fang Long ranks third.
They are both 15 years old this year.
"Brother, you actually know how to cook? What delicious food did you cook?" Fang Siyue looked curiously at the kitchen. There was no sign of cooking.
"The high-energy nutritious meal has been heated and is being kept warm." Fang Yu said with a smile.
"Ah!" the girl wailed: "I knew it, brother, I wasted all my expectations of you for a long time, I don't eat nutritious meals, I want grandpa to order takeout for me!!!"
"Takeaway is not healthy. You have both started practicing martial arts, so you must pay attention to your diet." Fang Yu smiled and touched the other person's head lovingly.
Martial arts training.
Before reaching a very high level, you have to endure loneliness, endure all kinds of pain, and even give up many things, such as delicious food!
…
The eldest brother's fist is like that of his father.
Under Fang Yu's "obedient guidance", Fang Siyue and Fang Long "obediently" finished the high-energy nutritious meal prepared by Fang Yu.
After meal.
"How is the martial arts talent test?" Fang Yu asked proactively.
The two looked at each other and smiled.
"Brother, with the help of the instrument, we all fell into a deep sleep." Fang Long said with a smile: "My sister and I both visualized a star, which was a python, and made a preliminary attempt to 'enter the star power into the body'."
"Python?" Fang Yu's eyes lit up.
Before becoming a junior warrior, ordinary people are limited to a weak body and not strong enough mental power. Even if they awaken the void star, they will not be able to detect it.
Therefore, it is necessary to use special instruments to assist in entering a deep sleep state.
Only then can one determine whether the astrology is awakened.
This is an instrument that has only appeared in the past ten years or so, and it is also the reason why talented warriors of the Blue Moon Alliance have continued to emerge in recent years.
After all, the sooner you discover your talents, cultivate them earlier, and make perfect use of your golden training time, the higher the probability of becoming a super strong person in the future.
